_about: Hunting screen text. Family-friendly: animals fall or run off; nothing graphic.
hunt.title: Hunting
hunt.status.meat: Meat: {meat} of {carry} lb you can carry
hunt.action.done: Carry the meat back to the wagons
hunt.footer: Choose with the number keys or the mouse. A flintlock takes a long time to reload.
hunt.start: {who} takes the gun and goes out on foot. Ahead, a {animal} grazes far off.
hunt.start_empty: {who} takes the gun and goes out on foot. The veld is quiet; nothing is in sight yet.
hunt.spooked: The {animal} lifts its head, sees {who}, and is gone.
hunt.closer: {who} creeps closer, keeping low and downwind.
hunt.misfire: Click! The flint sparks but the powder does not catch. The {animal} looks up.
hunt.ran: The {animal} runs off over the rise.
hunt.kill: Bang! The {animal} falls. That is {n} lb of meat.
hunt.kill_too_much: Bang! The {animal} falls. You can only carry {n} lb more; the rest must be left.
hunt.kill_predator: Bang! The {animal} falls. The herd will be safer tonight.
hunt.wounded: The {animal} is hit, but not down.
hunt.wounded_ran: The wounded {animal} runs off. There is a trail of spoor to follow.
hunt.charged: The {animal} turns and charges! {who} is knocked down and hurt.
hunt.loaded: The gun is loaded and primed.
hunt.reloading: {who} pours powder, rams home the ball... {n} more to go.
hunt.followed: {who} follows the spoor and comes up on the wounded {animal}.
hunt.lost_spoor: The spoor is lost on stony ground. The {animal} is gone.
hunt.full: {who} has all the meat that can be carried: {n} lb.
hunt.sundown: The sun is going down. Time to go back.
journal.hunt: {who} went hunting and brought back meat: {fresh} lb fresh and {dried} lb dried as biltong.
journal.hunt_empty: {who} went hunting and came back with nothing.
travel.hunt_locked: Needs powder, lead and someone who can shoot
